cards.name: Set Matte

verified.note: No frame: card is needs_input (needs a matte layer reference the spec cannot set), so it was not rendered.

cards.summary: Replaces the layer's alpha with a channel (alpha, luminance, a colour channel, etc.) taken from another layer, so that layer acts as a matte. An effect-based track matte: it travels with the layer when precomposed and the matte layer can sit anywhere in the comp (hidden).
use_for: footage showing only inside big headline text or a map outline
luma-matte reveals driven by a grayscale wipe or ink-bleed layer
keeping a matte inside a precomp where track mattes break
hiding a photo outside a lower-third shape
avoid: matte layer left visible on top: turn its visibility off but keep it in the comp
mismatched layer sizes without stretch give misaligned mattes
feathered luminance mattes from noisy footage make dirty edges

params.name: Take Matte From Layer
params.does: the layer that supplies the matte (layer reference)
params.typical: a hidden text/shape/gradient layer in the same comp

params.name: Use For Matte
params.does: which channel of that layer becomes this layer's alpha
params.typical: 4 (Alpha Channel) for text/shapes, 5 (Luminance) for grayscale wipes

params.name: Invert Matte
params.does: flips the matte (show outside instead of inside)

params.name: If Layer Sizes Differ
params.does: checkbox: stretch the matte layer to fit this layer
params.typical: 1 when matte layer is a different size

params.name: Composite Matte with Original
params.does: multiplies the new matte with the layer's existing alpha

params.name: Premultiply Matte Layer
params.does: premultiplies the matte layer (with the comp background) before its channel is read; avoids fringes on soft/antialiased matte edges

cards.scripting: Take Matte From Layer is a layer-reference property: set it with the matte layer's index (layer.index), not a name; the spec system cannot set it, so the script must add the matte layer first and then assign the index. Checkbox values are 0/1. The Use For Matte order above (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha, Luminance, Hue, Lightness, Saturation, Full, Off) is read from After Effects 26.0. The matte layer's transforms (position/scale/rotation) are never used; whether its masks and effects are used depends on the Source / Masks / Effects & Masks popup beside the layer menu, which this spec cannot set (unverified default). Safest: precompose the matte layer (text, shapes, animated wipes) so everything is baked into its source.

cards.name: Shift Channels

verified.note: Red/blue swap is obvious: red stripes turn blue, navy areas turn brown, red foreground blocks turn purple.

cards.summary: Rebuilds the red, green, blue and alpha channels from other channels of the same layer (e.g. red from blue). Gives instant false-colour swaps or a channel extracted as greyscale.
use_for: glitch/hacked flash frames in tech or cyber-crime explainers
surreal false-colour swap for music-driven reel beats
pulling a single channel as greyscale to build a luma matte
quick colour-swap for stylised 'alternate reality' segments
avoid: on faces of real politicians in straight news: reads as mockery
setting Take Alpha From to a colour/luminance channel makes dark areas transparent: keep it at 1 (Alpha) unless a matte is intended

params.name: Take Red From
params.does: source channel for red output

params.name: Take Green From
params.does: source channel for green output

params.name: Take Blue From
params.does: source channel for blue output

params.name: Take Alpha From
params.does: source channel for alpha

cards.scripting: All four are popup indices 1-10. Order 1-8 (Alpha, Red, Green, Blue, Luminance, Hue, Lightness, Saturation) matches the harvested defaults (alpha=1, red=2, green=3, blue=4); 9 Full On and 10 Full Off complete the menu, all read from After Effects 26.0. Premiere 2026 has no channel-swap effect (its Channel Mix only scales/inverts channels), so do swaps in AE. Popups are not smoothly animatable: for flicker glitches use hold keyframes on a few frames.

cards.name: Solid Composite

verified.note: Whole frame carries a strong flat blue wash at 55% source opacity, image still readable underneath.

cards.summary: Composites a solid colour behind the layer with its own opacity and blending mode. Lowering Source Opacity lets the colour wash through, giving a flat tint, or fills transparent areas with a colour.
use_for: brand-colour wash behind a still so headline text reads on top
filling transparent edges of a cut-out photo with a flat colour
dimming and tinting B-roll for a quote card background
fading a shot toward a colour instead of black
avoid: no effect on a fully opaque layer at Source Opacity 100 with Normal mode
heavy washes flatten faces and look cheap on hero shots

params.name: Source Opacity
params.does: opacity of the original layer over the solid
params.typical: 40-70 for a wash; 100 to only fill transparent areas

params.name: Color
params.does: colour of the solid underneath
params.typical: brand colour, e.g. #0B1F3A navy or #FF6A00 saffron

params.name: Opacity
params.does: opacity of the solid itself

params.name: Blending Mode
params.does: how the solid blends with the source

cards.scripting: Color is set as "#RRGGBB" (alpha ignored). Blending Mode is a 1-21 popup with separators at 2, 9, 12 and 17: 1 Normal, 3 Add, 4 Multiply, 5 Screen, 6 Overlay ... (enum_labels, read from After Effects 26.0). Keyframe Source Opacity for a fade-to-colour. Premiere 2026 has no Solid Composite: put a Color Matte on the track below and lower the clip's Opacity instead.

cards.name: Cineware

verified.note: No frame: card is unusable (Cinema 4D not installed), so it was not rendered.

cards.summary: Renders a Cinema 4D (.c4d) scene layer inside After Effects, with camera and multi-pass extraction. On this machine it fails because Cinema 4D 2025 is not installed.
use_for: 3D logo or object renders inside AE (only after installing Cinema 4D)
3D map/globe scenes for explainers (only after installing Cinema 4D)
avoid: applying it to normal footage: it does nothing without a .c4d layer
scripted use on this machine: errors at sequence setup
cards.scripting: Harvest failed: 'Cinema 4D 2025 must be installed in order to use Cineware by Maxon'. No properties could be read. Do not plan with it; use AE 3D layers, Advanced 3D renderer, or pre-rendered 3D clips instead. Would also need a .c4d file layer (needs_input) even when installed.

cards.name: Auto Color

verified.note: Strong auto contrast stretch: deeper blacks in the dark clothing, whiter wall, colours more saturated and neutral.

cards.summary: Automatically balances colour and contrast by analysing shadows, midtones and highlights, removing casts. With Snap Neutral Midtones it pushes near-grey tones to neutral grey.
use_for: quick fix for yellow/green cast on phone or CCTV news footage
normalising mixed archival clips in a documentary montage
first-pass correction on rally or press-conference B-roll
avoid: Temporal Smoothing 0 on moving shots causes frame-to-frame flicker
high clip values crush flags and dark suits
can neutralise intended warm/sunset looks

params.name: Temporal Smoothing (seconds)
params.does: averages the analysis over neighbouring frames to stop flicker

params.name: Scene Detect
params.does: restarts smoothing at cuts (only works with smoothing > 0)

params.name: Black Clip
params.does: percent of darkest pixels clipped to black

params.name: White Clip
params.does: percent of brightest pixels clipped to white

params.name: Snap Neutral Midtones
params.does: forces near-neutral midtones to true grey

params.name: Blend With Original
params.does: mixes back the uncorrected image (percent)

cards.scripting: Checkboxes (Scene Detect, Snap Neutral Midtones) are 0/1 numbers. Analysis is per frame, so results change with content; set Temporal Smoothing for any moving shot. Clip values are percentages 0-10; the demo's 6% is deliberately strong so the change shows, use 0.1-1 in real work. Premiere 2026 has no Auto Color effect; Lumetri Color's Auto button is a UI action, so a script must set Lumetri values explicitly.

cards.name: Auto Contrast

verified.note: Contrast clearly stretched: dark clothing near black, background near white, colour balance roughly unchanged.

cards.summary: Automatically stretches overall contrast so the darkest pixels go black and the brightest go white, without shifting colour balance.
use_for: reviving flat, hazy archive or TV-grab footage
giving dull screen recordings or phone clips more punch
first-pass contrast on mixed B-roll in explainers
avoid: flicker on moving shots when Temporal Smoothing is 0
high clip values crush shadow detail in dark suits and night rallies

params.name: Temporal Smoothing (seconds)
params.does: averages analysis over time to avoid flicker

params.name: Scene Detect
params.does: resets smoothing at cuts (needs smoothing > 0)

params.name: Black Clip
params.does: percent of dark pixels clipped to black

params.name: White Clip
params.does: percent of bright pixels clipped to white

params.name: Blend With Original
params.does: mix back the original (percent)

cards.scripting: Scene Detect is a 0/1 checkbox. Clip values are percentages 0-10; the demo's 6% is deliberately strong, use 0.1-1 in real work. Set Temporal Smoothing on any moving shot. Premiere 2026 has no Auto Contrast effect: set Lumetri Color Contrast/Whites/Blacks explicitly.

cards.name: Auto Levels

verified.note: Per-channel stretch gives punchy contrast plus a slight warm shift versus the source.

cards.summary: Automatically sets black and white points for each colour channel separately, stretching contrast and often removing (or sometimes adding) colour casts.
use_for: fast fix for washed-out or tinted archival scans
normalising screenshots and phone footage before grading
rescuing underexposed CCTV or dashcam clips in news
avoid: per-channel stretch can introduce new colour casts
flicker on moving footage without Temporal Smoothing
crushes subtle low-key cinematic grades

params.name: Temporal Smoothing (seconds)
params.does: averages analysis over time to avoid flicker

params.name: Scene Detect
params.does: resets smoothing at cuts (needs smoothing > 0)

params.name: Black Clip
params.does: percent of dark pixels clipped per channel

params.name: White Clip
params.does: percent of bright pixels clipped per channel

params.name: Blend With Original
params.does: mix back the original (percent)

cards.scripting: Scene Detect is a 0/1 checkbox. Clip values are percentages 0-10; the demo's 6% is deliberately strong, use 0.1-1 in real work. Prefer Auto Contrast when the colour balance must stay as shot. Premiere 2026 has no Auto Levels effect: use Levels or Lumetri Color with explicit values.

cards.name: Black & White

verified.note: Clean greyscale conversion with light skin and mid-grey red stripes, no tint.

cards.summary: Converts the image to monochrome, with sliders controlling how bright each original hue (reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas) becomes in grey. Optional tint for sepia or cyanotype looks.
use_for: flashback or 'history' segments in documentaries
archival feel on old political speeches and press photos
freeze-frame B&W before a colour hit in trailers
sepia tint for pre-independence or historical recreations
desaturated background behind colour graphics
avoid: default weights can make skin muddy: raise Reds/Yellows
tint colours too saturated look fake

params.name: Reds
params.does: brightness of red areas in the grey result

params.name: Yellows
params.does: brightness of yellow areas

params.name: Greens
params.does: brightness of green areas

params.name: Blues
params.does: brightness of blue areas (skies, suits)

params.name: Tint:
params.does: checkbox: apply a colour tint

params.name: Tint Color
params.does: tint colour when Tint is on

cards.scripting: The checkbox property name is literally 'Tint:' with a colon. Tint Color is "#RRGGBB". No blend slider: for a colour-to-B&W transition keyframe the effect's Compositing Options/Effect Opacity (0-100) if the spec reaches it, otherwise put the effect on an adjustment layer and keyframe that layer's Opacity. Premiere's Black & White has no controls at all (plain greyscale); for weighted or tinted mono in Premiere use Lumetri Color.

cards.name: Brightness & Contrast

verified.note: Image is clearly brighter and lifted with more contrast, highlights near white but not hard-clipped.

cards.summary: Simple global brightness and contrast adjustment. The default (non-legacy) mode behaves like a gentle levels curve that protects highlights and shadows.
use_for: camera-flash hit on reveal beats in news reels and trailers
dimming a B-roll plate behind headline text
quick lift of underexposed press footage
contrast punch on social reels
avoid: Legacy mode clips highlights and blacks quickly
strong contrast on compressed footage reveals blocking

params.name: Brightness
params.does: overall brightness shift
params.typical: -60 to dim a plate, +10 to +30 lift, +120 flash

params.name: Contrast
params.does: overall contrast

params.name: Use Legacy (supports HDR)
params.does: checkbox: old linear method, clips but works with HDR/32-bit

cards.scripting: Checkbox is a 0/1 number. Brightness range -150..150, Contrast -100..100. Measured 2026-10-13 (live wave 2, the layout recipes' blurred backplates): at the same values (Brightness -35 / -45, Contrast -10) Premiere's Brightness & Contrast renders 10-27 levels darker than this effect (9:16 blur-fill mean RGB 126/115/127 here against 104/103/105 in Premiere). The two scales are not the same: do not copy values across apps without a check.

cards.name: Broadcast Colors

verified.note: Highlights are clamped: walls, faces and white stripes lose detail into flat hard-edged grey plateaus, so the limit is visible, not subtle.

cards.summary: Limits luminance or saturation so the picture stays within legal broadcast (NTSC/PAL) signal levels, or keys out the unsafe areas to show where they are.
use_for: final safety pass on content delivered to a TV news channel
taming super-saturated flags and graphics for broadcast
diagnosing illegal areas by keying them out
avoid: unneeded for Instagram/YouTube delivery: dulls highlights for no gain
IRE well below 100 (e.g. 90) clamps walls, faces and white flag stripes into flat, hard-edged grey blotches

params.name: Broadcast Locale
params.does: TV standard

params.name: How to Make Color Safe
params.does: method: reduce luminance, reduce saturation, or key out unsafe/safe areas

params.name: Maximum Signal Amplitude (IRE)
params.does: signal ceiling

cards.scripting: Premiere 2026 has the same Broadcast Colors effect (same three properties); Video Limiter is Premiere's more modern alternative. How to Make Color Safe is a 1-5 popup; the documented options are Reduce Luminance, Reduce Saturation, Key Out Unsafe, Key Out Safe (After Effects 26.0's menu: 1 Reduce Luminance, 2 Reduce Saturation, 3 a separator, 4 Key Out Unsafe, 5 Key Out Safe). The demo at 90 IRE (Reduce Luminance) visibly clamps highlights into flat, hard-edged plateaus on walls and faces; real broadcast work uses 100-110. Apply last in the chain.

cards.name: CC Color Neutralizer

verified.note: Split tone as described: shadows go blue/teal (R -20, B +20) and highlights go warm peach (R +23, B -31).

cards.summary: Removes or adds colour casts separately in shadows, midtones and highlights: pick the off-colour as an 'Unbalance' colour to neutralise it, or push red/green/blue per tonal range for split-tone grades.
use_for: neutralising a green or magenta cast in fluorescent-lit press rooms
teal shadows / warm highlights cinematic grade for trailers
matching two interview cameras shot under different light
cool documentary look by pushing blue into shadows
avoid: large offsets on skin go plastic or sickly
wrong Unbalance colour adds a cast instead of removing it

params.name: Midtones Unbalance
params.does: colour that should become neutral grey in midtones (eyedropper target)
params.typical: sample of the cast, e.g. #8A9070 for a green cast

params.name: Shadows Unbalance
params.does: the cast colour seen in the shadows; it is pulled to neutral black

params.name: Highlights Unbalance
params.does: the cast colour seen in the highlights; it is pulled to neutral white

params.name: Red - Shadows
params.does: manual red offset in shadows

params.name: Blue - Shadows
params.does: manual blue offset in shadows

params.name: Red - Highlights
params.does: manual red offset in highlights

params.name: Blue - Highlights
params.does: manual blue offset in highlights

params.name: Blend w. Original
params.does: mix back the original (percent)

cards.scripting: Property names are flat ('Red - Shadows', etc.); the Shadows/Midtones/Highlights headers are display groups only. Unbalance colours are "#RRGGBB"; defaults (black, 50% grey, white) mean no correction. View is a 1-3 popup: 1 Final Result, 2 Correction B to W, 3 Correction Stair (read from After Effects 26.0). Black Point is limited to 0-49.9 and White Point to 50.1-100. Direction of manual offsets (positive = more of that colour) is confirmed by the gallery render: the demo gave blue shadows and warm highlights.

cards.name: CC Color Offset

verified.note: Garish magenta/yellow false-colour psychedelic look across the whole frame.

cards.summary: Rotates the red, green and blue channel values by a phase angle, cycling colours around; overflow handling wraps, solarizes or polarizes values for psychedelic, solarized false-colour looks.
use_for: trippy colour-cycling transitions in music or meme reels
solarized 'hacked' or 'dream' sequences in AI-education explainers
one-frame colour flashes on beat drops in trailers
avoid: on real politicians in serious news: looks like mockery
large phases on skin are garish
full-length use tires viewers; keep to short beats

params.name: Red Phase
params.does: phase rotation of the red channel (degrees, 360 = full cycle)

params.name: Green Phase
params.does: phase rotation of the green channel

params.name: Blue Phase
params.does: phase rotation of the blue channel

params.name: Overflow
params.does: how values pushed past white are folded back: wrap (hard banding), solarize or polarize (smoother)
params.typical: 2 (default, believed Solarize); 1 (Wrap) only for deliberately harsh glitch frames

cards.scripting: Phase properties have no harvested min/max; they behave as angles in degrees (0-360 is one full cycle, larger values keep cycling). Overflow: 1 Wrap, 2 Solarize (the default), 3 Polarize (read from After Effects 26.0). Animate a phase linearly for colour cycling.
